image_description: A close-up portrait of a brown tabby cat resting on a wooden surface against a dark blue background. The cat has prominent ear tufts, green eyes, and distinct tabby markings including an M-shape on the forehead. To the left, there is a blurry red object that appears to be a soda can with illegible text.
